WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT block_size, blocks, cycles,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY block_size, blocks ORDER BY cycles) - 1 AS i,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY block_size, blocks) AS n
  FROM barriers_shared WHERE barrier = 'syncthreads')
SELECT block_size, blocks, cycles,
       CASE i WHEN 0 THEN 'min' WHEN n - 1 THEN 'max' WHEN (n - 1) / 2 THEN 'med'
              WHEN (n - 1) / 4 THEN 'q1' ELSE 'q3' END AS stat
FROM ranked
WHERE i IN (0, (n - 1) / 4, (n - 1) / 2, 3 * (n - 1) / 4, n - 1)

# a2av.cu figure, in the house style of dgx-spark/latency/plot/plotstyle.py.
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13,
    "legend.title_fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.3, "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 6,
}
# DSMEM methods in blues/purple, global-memory methods in oranges/red.
METHODS = {
    "dsmem-push": ("#1f77b4", "o"), "dsmem-pull": ("#17becf", "o"), "dsmem-bulk": ("#9467bd", "o"),
    "gmem-ldst": ("#ff7f0e", "s"), "gmem-tma": ("#d62728", "s"),
}
DISTRIBUTIONS = ["UNIMODALFLAT", "UNIMODALPEAK", "MONOTONEDECAY", "HEAVYTAIL"]


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)


def message_size_axis(ax, sizes):
    """log2 x axis labelled with the message sizes that were run."""
    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s}" if s < 1024 else f"{s // 1024} Ki" for s in sizes])


def panels(fig, distributions, rows, cols):
    """One axes per distribution present in the data, sharing both axes."""
    axes = fig.subplots(rows, cols, sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False).ravel()
    for ax in axes[len(distributions):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return list(zip(axes, distributions))


def one_legend(fig, axes):
    """A single legend above the panels instead of one per panel."""
    handles, labels = {}, {}
    for ax in axes:
        for h, l in zip(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels()):
            handles.setdefault(l, h)
    fig.legend(handles.values(), handles.keys(), loc="outside upper center",
               ncol=len(handles), frameon=False)

import numpy as np

TITLE, COLOR = "__syncthreads(), one block (shared: every thread, + shared load)", "#1f77b4"


def boxes(axis, part, color):
    """One box per block size, from the 5 rows (stat = min, q1, med, q3, max)
    the SQL computed for it. Returns the highest whisker, so the caller can
    set one y range for all its panels."""
    sizes = sorted(part["block_size"].unique())
    stats = []
    for s in sizes:
        q = part[part["block_size"] == s].set_index("stat")["cycles"]
        stats.append({"whislo": q["min"], "q1": q["q1"], "med": q["med"], "q3": q["q3"],
                      "whishi": q["max"], "fliers": []})
    axis.bxp(stats, positions=range(len(sizes)), widths=0.6, patch_artist=True,
             boxprops={"facecolor": color, "alpha": 0.35, "edgecolor": color},
             medianprops={"color": color, "linewidth": 2.2},
             whiskerprops={"color": color}, capprops={"color": color})
    top = 0
    for i, st in enumerate(stats):
        # the median, written just above the upper whisker (the max)
        axis.text(i, st["whishi"], f"{st['med']:.0f}\n", ha="center", va="bottom",
                  fontsize=12, color="0.25")
        top = max(top, st["whishi"])
    axis.set_xticks(range(len(sizes)))
    axis.set_xticklabels([str(int(s)) for s in sizes])
    axis.set_xlabel("threads per block")
    axis.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)
    axis.grid(False, axis="x")
    return top

    blocks = sorted(df["blocks"].unique())
    start(fig, (7 + 6 * (len(blocks) - 1), 6))
    axes = fig.subplots(1, len(blocks), sharey=True, squeeze=False)[0]
    top = 0
    for axis, n in zip(axes, blocks):
        top = max(top, boxes(axis, df[df["blocks"] == n], COLOR))
        if len(blocks) > 1:
            axis.set_title(f"{n} blocks")
    for axis in axes:
        axis.set_ylim(0, top * 1.15)   # room for the median labels
    axes[0].set_ylabel("cycles per thread")
    fig.suptitle(TITLE)
